name: webchat-api
description: OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible API over a real webchat tab (Puppeteer) with tool-call support

scripts.check: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && node --check server.js && node --check cli/index.js && node --check src/tools/tools.js && node --check src/browser/browser.js && node --check bin/webchat.js
scripts.test: npm run build && node --test --test-concurrency=1 harness_tests/*.test.js && node harness_tests/cli_smoke.js && bash harness_tests/verify-launchers.sh
scripts.test:smoke: npm run build && node harness_tests/cli_smoke.js && bash harness_tests/verify-launchers.sh
